actions.reason: C0001 has coherent biological identity evidence (strong, coherent down-regulation of metabolic Hallmark programs) with no significant technical confounding and stable internal structure; WXS signal is weak but not contradictory. Retained for downstream validation despite residual uncertainty from near-zero silhouette magnitudes and partial cross-modal membership support.

C0002 has significant DST mutation enrichment and coherent up-regulation of metabolic/peroxisomal programs, with no significant technical confounding. Internal structure is weakly stable (ARI 0.50, PAC 0.78), so retention is uncertain but no positive structural evidence supports split or merge.

C0003 has strong, highly significant BAP1 enrichment and a coherent inflammatory/immune transcriptional signature, with no significant technical confounding and relatively better cross-modal membership support. Retained for downstream validation despite small set size and near-zero silhouette magnitudes.

C0004 has significant near-universal VHL mutation enrichment with no significant technical confounding. Structure is dominated by WXS with limited cross-modal membership support, so retention is uncertain but no positive structural evidence supports split or merge.

C0005 membership is significantly associated with tissue source site and CT scanner model, providing a plausible technical/site competing explanation for the defining signal; this confounder concern makes the candidate insufficiently defensible for retention.

C0006 has significant, large-magnitude depletion of VHL and PBRM1 with no significant technical confounding and highly stable internal structure. Membership support is predominantly WXS-driven, so retention is uncertain but no positive structural evidence supports split or merge.
